decisions.reason: The upgraded trommel screen meets aspirations given its established base and positive customer feedback, so slack and low uncertainty keep drop probability very low.
The flail shredder line has had time to develop demand under slack, and with no evidence of below-aspiration results it remains likely kept.
The stationary fine shredder is a niche product with limited visibility, so uncertainty is higher, but slack and lack of clear failure support keeping it.
The green-waste grinder is a specialized version that survived the general grinder withdrawal, but overlap keeps some uncertainty; slack still allows carrying it.
